items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: The mention of 'Abraham' refers to a biblical figure or a descriptor on an ID card ('Son of Abraham', 'descendant of the Father Abraham'), not a personal acquaintance of Danny Barker.

ctx.x: Yeah, you all had to get out of there and go somewhere else.
Yeah. Well, Mushid(?) was so defiant. Looked that man right straight in the eye, and the man reads that, says, "Son of Abraham..."
Yeah, he had a beard... They wore a goatee and beard.
